story.title: Our Story
story.body: Yasmine was established in Amman in 2008. The experience behind it goes back to 1989: years spent making molds and servicing plastic machinery for other manufacturers, learning the trade from the inside. When the time felt right, we started making products of our own. We have been growing steadily since.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To deliver high-quality, durable, and customisable plastic packaging solutions that meet the real-world needs of our clients,on time, at the right price, with the flexibility to adapt. We measure success by our clients' satisfaction and the long-term relationships we build together.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: We believe the Arab world shouldn't have to import what it can make well locally. Our vision is to keep improving our craft and expanding our reach across the Arab world, showing that Arab manufacturing can deliver the quality businesses depend on.

values.title: Our Values
values.body: Quality, reliability, transparency, and partnership define everything we do. We treat every client relationship as a long-term collaboration, not a transaction. We hold ourselves accountable to the highest standards,in our materials, our processes, and our service.
